## Context

Current TODO.md:
!`cat TODO.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(no TODO.md in this repo)"`

Existing plans:
!`ls docs/plans/ 2>/dev/null | tail -20`

Today:
!`date -u +%F`

## Your task

**$ARGUMENTS**

Pick the next TODO item, rank it if it is unranked, and get it done by the cheapest
model that can actually do it. The tier table lives in `~/CLAUDE.md` — Delegation.

---

### 1. Select the item

In priority order:

1. If `$ARGUMENTS` is non-empty, match it against open item titles (substring, case
   insensitive). More than one match → list them and stop; ask which.
2. Else the first `[wip …]` item in document order — work in flight beats work not
   started, and it may already have a live agent to re-message.
3. Else the first `[verify …]` item — verification is cheap and unblocks a Done line.
4. Else the first open item in document order.

Skip the auto-captured deferrals inbox (the `<!-- BEGIN auto-captured-deferrals -->`
block) unless it is the only thing left — those are untriaged by design.

If `## Open` is empty, say so and stop. Do not invent work.

---

### 2. Rank it if it has no tier

An unranked item (`- [ ]`) defaults to **T3**, but do not just accept the default —
rank it properly against the rubric in `/todo`, then **write the tier back into
`TODO.md`** before dispatching. State the rank and a one-line reason.

**You do this yourself, inline. Ranking is T5 and is never delegated** — deciding the tier
is the step that routes everything after it, and it cannot be handed to the thing being
routed. Only dispatch once the tier is settled.

---

### 3. Dispatch

**T5 → do it yourself, inline.** No agent. This is the correct answer for judgment
calls, plan decisions, final integration, and anything you could finish in under ~3
tool calls. Spawning costs a full brief plus a cold read; below that threshold
dispatching is a loss.

**T0–T4 → check for a live agent first.** This is the step that does not happen by
default and is where most of the savings are:

1. Grep `TODO.md` for `<!-- agent:… -->` stamps on other `[wip …]` items.
2. Add any agents you spawned earlier this session.
3. If one of them already holds relevant context — same subsystem, same files, same
   plan — **`SendMessage` it** with the new work instead of spawning. A fresh agent
   re-pays for every file the live one has already read.
4. Only spawn when nothing live applies:

   | Tier | `subagent_type` |
   |---|---|
   | T0 | `t0-lookup` |
   | T1 | `t1-sonnet-med` |
   | T2 | `t2-sonnet-high` |
   | T3 | `t3-opus-med` |
   | T4 | `t4-opus-high` |

   Never pass an explicit `model` — the tier agent's frontmatter carries model and
   effort. Never dispatch Fable; the `PreToolUse[Agent]` hook denies it.

**Brief it properly.** The agent starts cold. Include: the item text verbatim, the
linked plan path (say "read it first" when one exists), the concrete files involved,
how to verify, and what is explicitly out of scope. A vague brief is how a correctly
ranked task still fails.

---

### 4. Mark it in flight

Before dispatching, edit the item in `TODO.md`:

- Set the status to `wip`, keeping the tier: `- [T3] **Title**` → `- [wip T3] **Title**`
- Stamp the agent id at end of line: `<!-- agent:a7a12a1f88b6840b4 -->`
- On a `SendMessage` reuse, update the stamp to that agent's id.
- T5 work gets `[wip T5]` and **no stamp** — you are the one doing it.

---

### 5. On completion

- **Success** → `/todo done: <title>`, which removes the item from `## Open`, inserts a
  one-line entry at the top of `## Done`, drops the tier, and strips the agent stamp.
- **Code landed but unverified** → set `[verify T<n>]`, keep the stamp, and say what
  verification is outstanding.
- **Agent returned `ESCALATE:`** → re-rank one tier up, write the new tier back, and
  re-dispatch. Do not argue it back down, and do not quietly finish it inline without
  recording that the original rank was wrong — a repeated mis-rank is a rubric problem
  worth noticing.
- **Failure** → leave the item `[wip T<n>]` with its stamp, and report what broke with
  the actual output. Never report a pass you did not observe.

---

### Reporting

Close with a compact summary: the item, its tier, whether you reused an agent or spawned
one (and which), what changed, and the verification result. If you left anything in
scope unfinished, say so explicitly.
